name: Seven
source:
As resurrection of an evil god draws near, a goddess sends a team of seven young people - two men and five women - to fight the apostles and prevent evil god's resurrection.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
随着邪神复活之日临近，一位女神派出由七名年轻人组成的队伍——两男五女——去对抗使徒，阻止邪神复活。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
